title: Council of Europe Engagement
description: Building a strategy for AI safety training for judges and a conference at the Council of Europe, with Dr. Anca Radu.

blocks.heading: Council of Europe Engagement
blocks.lede: Building a strategy for ==AI safety training for judges==, and a conference at the Council of Europe that results in a concrete output.

blocks.quote: How can Europe’s judicial institutions prepare for AI risk, not just AI cases?

blocks.body:
We are working with Dr. [Anca Radu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raduanca/), an expert in the fields of AI × judicial systems, cyberjustice, and the Council of Europe, to produce a strategy for engagement with the Council of Europe.

**Our ambition:**

- Provide AI safety training for judges from the European Court of Human Rights.
- Organise a conference at the Council of Europe that results in a concrete output.

blocks.heading: Help us make this happen
blocks.intro: These opportunities for AI risk reduction carry substantial costs. That is why we are seeking funding and partners who want to collaborate with us on this workstream.
blocks.closedMessage: Applications aren't open right now. Email [info@lawforaisafety.org](mailto:info@lawforaisafety.org) to register your interest.
